name: Iberia Credit Card

base_rate.description: 1 Avios per $1 on all other purchases.

rewards.redemption_notes: Avios points earned during a billing cycle will be automatically transferred to Iberia after the end of each billing cycle. Avios points expire according to Iberia Plus Program Terms and Conditions (36 consecutive months of inactivity).

signup_bonus.description: Earn 75,000 Avios after you spend $5,000 on purchases within the first 3 months of account opening.

benefits.title: $1,000 Airfare Discount Voucher each calendar year
benefits.description: Earn a discount voucher of $1,000 to use toward two tickets on the same Iberia flight for each calendar year you make purchases of $30,000 on your card.

benefits.title: 10% discount on Iberia airfare
benefits.description: Get a 10% discount on airfare when you book your flight on the website provided in your welcome materials using your Iberia Visa Signature Card.

benefits.title: Baggage Delay Insurance
benefits.description: Reimburses you up to $100 a day for up to 3 days for essential purchases when baggage is delayed over 6 hours.

benefits.title: Purchase Protection
benefits.description: Covers eligible new purchases for 120 days from date of purchase against damage or theft up to $500 per item.

benefits.title: Lost Luggage Reimbursement
benefits.description: Provides reimbursement up to $3,000 per covered traveler for cost to repair or replace checked or carry-on baggage that is lost, damaged or stolen during a covered trip.

benefits.title: Extended Warranty Protection
benefits.description: Extends the manufacturer's U.S. warranty by an additional year, on eligible warranties of three years or less, up to four years from date of purchase.

benefits.title: Complimentary DoorDash DashPass
benefits.description: Get one-year complimentary DashPass membership for both DoorDash and Caviar, providing unlimited deliveries with $0 delivery fees and lower service fees on eligible orders. Activate by Dec 31, 2027.

benefits.title: Contactless - Just Tap To Pay
benefits.description: For fast, easy and secure checkout simply tap to pay where you see the Contactless symbol.

benefits.title: Spend Instantly
benefits.description: Apply for a card and use it the same day by adding it to a digital wallet like Apple Pay, Google Pay or Samsung Pay.

benefits.title: Chase Pay Over Time
benefits.description: Break up credit card purchases into budget friendly payments. After purchase: pay off eligible purchases of $100 or more in smaller equal monthly payments. No interest, just a fixed monthly fee.

other: $1,000 Airfare Discount Voucher each calendar year after $30,000 spend

notes: Verified from official Chase product page. Network corrected from mastercard/world to visa/signature based on page title 'Iberia Visa Signature® Credit Card'.
